definition.name: Digital · internal candidate v1
definition.description: UNAPPROVED CANDIDATE · INTERNAL EVIDENCE PILOT. Human evidence capture only; not an official GTI standard. No conditional rules, skip, external dispatch, procurement, automatic tasks or archive. After all stages, project closure still requires a separately Director-approved per-project document policy, actual Owner completion request and separate Director final decision. Blueprint gti-digital revision 1; source 2026-09-29 SHA-256 4d86f90d173a406ad9f3a5ffbba7ce55776b5d209f4bc2a0e4653f299d61b944. Never store passwords, API keys, recovery codes or other secrets in fields, comments or files. Use non-secret account identifiers and ownership references only; no credential vault or verified access transfer is provided. Source P0185/P0201–P0202 requires maintenance without a fixed end date, tasks and ongoing costs. This candidate has seven execution stages, no eighth maintenance stage and no MAINTENANCE status or cost ledger. Launch & Handover does not auto-close the project. Normal existing tasks may be created manually while the project genuinely remains ACTIVE. Business must decide defined or indefinite maintenance and final closure triggers; any closure still requires a Director-approved document policy, actual Owner request and separate Director decision. COMPLETED projects remain immutable. No verified deployment, UAT engine, bug-to-stage gate or external vendor workflow. Internal candidate choice: requiredness, bounds, file counts, reviewer routing and fixed gates need business confirmation.
